name: Genuss Schmied'n Stadlerhof
kurzbeschreibung:
**Indulge at Schmied’n Stadlerhof in Tirol**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality at **Schmied’n Stadlerhof**, a cozy alpine retreat nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Savor traditional dishes like hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy **Speckknödel**, and aromatic **Gröstl**, all crafted with local ingredients. Whether you’re unwinding after a day on the slopes or enjoying a leisurely breakfast with a view of the **Zillertal Alps**, this family-run farmhouse promises warmth, flavor, and the true spirit of **Tirol**.

<iframe src="https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=..." width="600" height="450" style="border:0;" allowfullscreen="" loading="lazy"></iframe>

**Come for the food, stay for the stories**—where every meal feels like a homecoming. **Willkommen im Schmied’n Stadlerhof!**
